reuse.why: Builds on the existing assertNotLinkedElsewhere/assertNotClosed guards, but releaseLinks re-writes the unlink field-clearing update from unlinkAccount instead of extracting and sharing it.

duplication.why: The null-out updateAccount block in releaseLinks is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount, and the Akahu/EnableBanking branches repeat an inline replaceExistingLink ? findLinkedElsewhere : [] conditional.

placement.why: All logic stays in accounts/app.ts next to the existing link guards, which is where the tree puts link rules.

scope.why: Only the flag, the lookup/assert split and the release call in each link handler are touched.

maintainability.why: Workable, but the 'unlinked account' state is now defined in two places that can drift, and the six handlers each carry the flag plumbing by hand.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No abstraction is bypassed; the unlink clearing simply was not extracted (counted as duplication).

disguised_duplication.where: releaseLinks in accounts/app.ts copies the unlinkAccount updateAccount block openly, not disguised.
